label: sec:braid-symmetric
html: At the classical limit q = 1, the quadratic Hecke relation (\sigma_i - 1)(\sigma_i + 1) = 0 reduces to the involution \sigma_i^2 = 1, and the braid group B_n factors through the symmetric group S_n. This section records the Artin presentation of B_n, its \mathrm{SU}(2) representation on the two-dimensional fundamental fibre, the Rolfsen and torus-knot indexing conventions used throughout the monograph, and the fundamental knot operator basis that lifts permutation characters to q-deformed braid operators.
